articles.text: ĀNDÉSĒN FŪREN: Qǐng ni gěi wo kànkan nèige huāpíng.
MRS. ANDERSON: Please give me that vase to look at.
DIÀNYUÁN: Nèige? Zhèige lánde, háishi zhèige hóngde?
SHOP ASSISTANT: Which one? This blue one or this red one?
ĀNDÉSĒN FŪREN: Nèi liǎngge dōu gěi wo kànkan, hǎo ma?
MRS. ANDERSON: Give me both of them to look at. All right?
DIÀNYUÁN: Hǎo. Nín kàn zhèige zěnmeyàng?
SHOP ASSISTANT: Certainly. What do you think of this one?
ĀNDÉSĒN FŪREN: Lánde tài guì le. Hóngde piányi yìdiǎnr.
MRS. ANDERSON: The blue one is too expensive. The red one is a little cheaper.
DIÀNYUÁN: Nǐ yǒu dà yìdiǎnrde ma? Zhèige dàde zhēn hǎokàn.
SHOP ASSISTANT: Do you want one a little larger? This large one is really nice looking.
ĀNDÉSĒN FŪREN: Hǎo, wǒ mǎi dàde ba.
MRS. ANDERSON: Okay, I'll buy the large one, I guess.
SHOP ASSISTANT: How many do you want?
